top_signals.title: Hammack Says the Fed Needs to 'Act Now' on Inflation
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack says the US labor market is "broadly stable" while inflation has been missing the central bank's target during an event with the Dayton Area Chamber of Commerce in Kettering, Ohio. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: The Next School of War: Educating for Tomorrow’s Battlefield
top_signals.summary:
When war changes, schools change. New technology, the politics of mass mobilization and campaign design, and novel tactics that defined Napoleonic warfare led to Gerhard von Scharnhorst’s reforms and the idea of lifelong education as a professional obligation. The pattern repeated itself in the interwar period. In 1929, James Carson Breckinridge, a Marine officer, published “Some Thoughts on Service Schools” in the Marine Corps Gazette, calling for a new educational paradigm consistent with John Dewey’s ideas about pragmatism and experiential learning.War is again changing.
